The "'''Savant ship slave rig'''" was a model of [[slave circuit]] produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The slave circuit sold for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and allowed a ship to be operated remotely.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
